verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ACH credits and debits, returns (ACH status becomes 'returned' with error code), and a generic webhook system that can subscribe to ACH events, satisfying the core origination and returns pieces. However, there is no explicit documentation of same-day ACH processing windows, NOC (Notification of Change) objects, or reversal objects as first-class entities with dedicated webhooks. Missing for 10: same-day ACH window support, NOC modeling, reversal object/webhook documentation.
